assets.subject: A VERY ROUND GOLDEN-YELLOW SOYBEAN, almost a perfect sphere, with short brown hilum seam. A comically undersized burgundy waistcoat strains around its round belly. Two soft round eyes glance downward in astonishment, one raised curved brow and a tiny open O mouth make a funny 'wait, what?' face, a single little sweat drop, no visible teeth. Its short feet are splayed apart as it clings to the purse. One escaping coin balances precariously on a toe. Lovable clumsiness, comic surprise. Bean body unmistakably round and yellow, NOT a recolored red kidney bean. Keep coin count small and readable.

assets.subject: A SMALL BRIGHT-GREEN MUNG BEAN courier with straight-sided short capsule-shaped body and pale hilum.
